metadata.purpose: Hold each source value until its own selected duration emits a next; allow overlapping waits.

cardinality.signature: delayWhen : T* -> T* (time-shifted subset for delayWhen)
conditions: One inner per source value, independent concurrency and retained payload identity.
Only a timer firing/duration next emits a value; empty selected duration discards it.
Outer completion waits for admitted inner work; error/cancellation discard.

scope.parameters: Observable-valued duration selector; no deprecated subscriptionDelay overload.
scope.callbacks: Indexed selector invoked once per source next; modeled as correlated return/throw outcomes.
scope.time: Schedulers and duration sources own time; the model only uses supplied now and ordered events.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant notifications and selector resolution; no callback-driven source reentry.
exclusions: Promise/iterable input conversion, Date absolute delay, custom schedulers, deprecated subscriptionDelay.
Reentrant producer/observer/finalizer, cancellation during callback delivery, universal metric-time guarantee.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire source at downstream subscription; each value independently admits its duration.

ownership.sharing: No implicit sharing or replay; multiple independent live timers/durations.
ownership.reset: Fresh counter and pending list on every output subscription.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Each value enters a separately owned duration. A timer/first duration next releases that value. Completion waits; error aborts.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between any source, timer or duration events.
Before late timer firing after cancellation.
